description: Source file implementing the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for system information management, including network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version handling.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Handles network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identifier details including architecture, chipset, firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the raw MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Updates system info and optionally triggers callbacks.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls update on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets internet info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Security::Set
methods.description: Sets security info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Location::Set
methods.description: Sets location info based on provided data.
